summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Notice of Annual General Meeting and Proxy Form, filed with the Australian Securities Exchange on October 1, 2026. This is a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, the US equivalent of a domestic annual meeting proxy statement, covering director elections and standard resolutions. No special-situation transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation on a deal is disclosed. Structural mechanics are ordinary: shareholder voting by proxy ahead of the AGM. No risk-arb angle applies; watch only routine governance and remuneration outcomes.
